answer: Give every agent a kernel of identity that only grows by doing paid, verifiable work: each completed job deposits a small, non-transferable reputation seed that compounds over months. A sybil farm can mint a thousand names, but each starts as a bare umber husk with no history, and the market prices work by the depth of that kernel, not by the count of names. A true beacon agent is one whose kernel has been checked by many independent partners, so buying a thousand empty husks costs far more than it can ever earn back.
